title: New MSFS 2024 activities: A310 Condor Route, Longitude challenges & bush trips!
description:
Looking to add purpose, structured airline schedules, and rugged backcountry expeditions to your flight log in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace just expanded with five brand-new activity and mission packages from Perfect Flight, Koschi, and Nordheim Missions, offering completely different styles of flying. Whether you want to hand-fly high-altitude corporate jet approaches in the Citation Longitude, retrace historic widebody routes across South America in the Airbus A310, work 12 scheduled airline turns in India with the A320neo, or explore the fjords and peaks of New Zealand and Canada, this week's drop delivers hundreds of hours of focused flying!

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear categories, review prerequisite requirements, and inspect panel variants so you can choose your next adventure fast:

✈️ COMMERCIAL FLEET OPERATIONS & LONG-HAUL ROTATIONS
We kick things off with structured airline schedules and widebody operations:
- 12LEGS – Vistara Fall 2026 (by Perfect Flight): Step into the flight deck of the iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2 for 12 scheduled IFR legs across India. Operating between FL340 and FL360 with standard airways, authentic SIDs/STARs, custom soundscapes, an in-game briefing panel, and over 100 monitored events.
- A310: Condor Route (by Perfect Flight): Take the free default iniBuilds Airbus A310-300 across South America. Retrace the legendary Condor Route across Argentina, Brazil, and Chile over subtropical waterfalls, glacial lakes, and the towering Andes across 12 scenic missions complete with custom livery and dynamic mission audio.

🛩️ EXECUTIVE JET HANDLING CHALLENGES
Ready for high-speed corporate jet operations?
- Longitude Captain – Flight Challenges (by Perfect Flight): 12 demanding executive legs spanning Europe and North America (including London Gatwick to Samedan and Madrid to Sion) flown at FL410–FL450 with steep glideslopes and high-density altitude arrivals.

⚠️ BUYER'S NOTICE: This add-on requires the MSFS Premium Deluxe edition to access the Cessna Citation Longitude, and the included "Black Aviation" livery is currently restricted to MSFS 2020 while missions run in MSFS 2024!

🏔️ SCENIC BUSH FLYING & MOUNTAIN EXCURSIONS
Looking to test your stick-and-rudder skills across wilderness strips?
- Adventure New Zealand (by Koschi & Nordheim Missions): Two scenic bush trips covering the North Island (flown in the Diamond DA62) and the South Island (Cessna 172), taking you over alpine peaks, deep fjords, and famous movie filming locations.
- Adventure Canada (by Koschi & Nordheim Missions): Massive backcountry touring across Western Canada, the Coast Mountains, and the Canadian Rockies. Packed with two multi-leg bush trips totaling 50+ hours of flying, plus custom mountain landing challenges.

Which of these new activities are you loading into your flight log first? Working airline turns in the A320, navigating the Andes in the A310, or bush flying across New Zealand? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace breakdown helped you find your next MSFS 2024 adventure, don't forget to hit that like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
